content.title: Makkah Defence Alliance Reviews Regional Security Situation
content.caption: The Makkah Defence Alliance met to review the evolving regional security situation and condemn attacks by Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia.

slides.heading: Makkah Defence Alliance Reviews Regional Security Situation
slides.text: The Makkah Defence Alliance met to review the evolving regional security situation and condemn attacks by Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia.

slides.heading: Meeting Details
slides.text: The Makkah Defence Alliance met in Islamabad to review the evolving regional security situation and condemn attacks by Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia.
slides.image_search_query: Makkah Defence Alliance meeting Saudi Arabia

slides.heading: Key Details
slides.text: The alliance condemned persistent and heinous attacks by Yemen's Houthis on civilians and civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, reaffirming their collective resolve to continue efforts in safeguarding Saudi Arabia’s security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity.
